Installation

  1. Download Millennium and follow the provided instructions to install the patcher.
  2. Open the Theme Page and click the Copy Theme ID button.
  3. Navigate to the Theme tab in the Millennium settings and select "Install Theme" and paste the Theme ID.

Voilà! Enjoy the new look of your Steam!

Info

  • Some things only work properly when steam is maximized on a 1920x1080p (or higher) monitor.
    • Smaller monitors may be properly supported later

Fully supported plugins

  • HLTB for Steam
  • Size on Disk

releases.name: INFO
releases.body:
From now on, this repository will be updated via commits only.
Previously, changes were collected and published as a release.
Now, updates are pushed directly through commits – there will be no more separate releases.

👉 Whenever new updates are available, they will appear in Millennium under the Update tab.
